description: This file contains utility functions for handling ZIP archive operations such as unzipping, zipping directories, and adding files to ZIP archives within the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions to unzip files to a directory, zip an entire directory, and zip a list of files, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: unzip
methods.description: Unzips the specified archive to the given directory using the unzip_file function.

methods.name: unzip_file
methods.description: Extracts a ZIP archive to a specified directory, with error handling, logging, and optional clean-up of cache for PHP files.

methods.name: zip_dir
methods.description: Zips an entire directory into an archive, creating the archive if it does not exist.

methods.name: zip_files_list
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from a list of files, optionally stripping a prefix from file paths.
